cat > /workspace/tmp/perf3.py <<'PYEOF'
import importlib.util
import json
import random
import subprocess
import sys
import time

spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("mainmod", "/workspace/submission/main.py")
mod = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
spec.loader.exec_module(mod)

rng = random.Random(23)
alphabet = ["s%d" % i for i in range(24)]
best = None
for trial in range(200):
    atoms = []
    for i in range(10):
        op = rng.choice(("endswith", "contains"))
        atoms.append((op, [rng.choice(alphabet) for _ in range(rng.randint(12, 16))]))
    monitors = [mod._monitor(op, list(p), alphabet) for op, p in atoms]
    try:
        states, trans = mod._build_product(monitors, len(alphabet))
    except mod.ReqError:
        continue
    if best is None or len(states) > best[0]:
        best = (len(states), atoms)
    if len(states) > 19000:
        break
print("product:", best[0])
atoms = best[1]
expr = {"op": "and", "args": [{"op": "not", "arg": {"op": op, "path": p}} for op, p in atoms]}
req = {"services": alphabet, "rules": [{"action": "allow", "when": expr}], "queries": [["s0"] * 50]}
payload = (json.dumps(req) + "\n").encode()
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-I", "/workspace/submission/main.py"], input=payload,
                   capture_output=True, timeout=300)
el = time.time() - t0
out = json.loads(p.stdout.decode())
print("time %.2fs bytes=%d minimized=%d" % (el, len(p.stdout), len(out["dfa"]["accept"])))
PYEOF
cd /workspace && python3 tmp/perf3.py
